eligibility.rule: At least 200 frozen eligible throws and ten eligible games in each season independently; team changes pool by raw GSIS ID.
eligibility.population: Recorded passers, not position-certified; frozen 560 actor-seasons; no adjacent-season requirement.
eligibility.model_limit: Generating CP/EP model and training vintage unknown; observed seasonal values are not era-neutral skill or forecasts.
eligibility.missing_player_season: No eligible record; do not substitute another year/player or a zero.

denominators.cpoe_pp: Mean supplied CPOE on E throws in the fixed air-yard bin; independent identity 100*mean(completion-cp). Depth-specific completion residual proxy, not isolated placement/accuracy.
denominators.game_frame: All seasonal E games, including zero-bin exposure; positive_bin_games counts only games with bin throws. No bin-volume threshold.

uncertainty.interval: Approximate marginal 95% conditional all-E-game deletion sensitivity: theta +/-1.96*sqrt((G-1)/G*sum((deletion-mean(deletion))^2)); no failed replicate drops or requalification.
uncertainty.limitations: Not calibrated talent confidence or prediction intervals; marginal bars neither test between-depth/player/year differences nor provide simultaneous 95% coverage across the three displayed axes. Independent game shocks/stable opportunity sampling/normal approximation may fail; excludes CP training/calibration, source labels, selection, receivers, coverage, protection and scheme uncertainty. Unknown CP vintage/calibration precludes era-neutral or causal comparisons.
uncertainty.collapsed: No observed deletion variation, not certainty.
uncertainty.geometry: Shared short/medium/deep native-pp domain across all 560 actor-seasons and endpoints plus zero. Negative is diagnostic only. Any later radius is display geometry, not a percentile, trait score or rating.

player_names.use: Display names only, exact raw GSIS ID match.
